UX surface Boot surfaces: what the user sees first on each bundle.

Members

SOLAR_RAW

Solar-system bodies — compressed orbits so all eight planets fit inside a single readable sweep around the Sun, then shrunken by SF_SCALE.SOLAR_SCALE (see shrinkSolar above). The literal is typed before mapping so pos keeps its tuple shape through the transform.

Spacing is eccentricity-aware: every adjacent pair keeps a clear limb gap even at worst-case conjunction (inner body's aphelion vs outer body's perihelion), so Mars can never crowd Earth's orbit the way a tighter compression allowed. Saturn clears Jupiter by its full ring extent (radius × RING_OUTER), and the asteroid belt sits between Mars's aphelion and Jupiter's perihelion like the real 2.06–3.27 AU band. Ryugu and Bennu intentionally cross Earth/Mars orbits — they are real near-Earth asteroids and read as flyby specks.
